events.description: Hazelton retained MI as Construction Manager under the Construction Management Agreement (CMA)
events.quote: pursuant to a Construction Management Agreement dated March 31, 2017
referenced_not_attached: CMA (Appendix G to the Fifth Report)

events.description: CEI and MI representatives met regularly for Hazelton Project updates and reviewed MI's invoices
events.quote: Between 2020 and 2023, representatives of CEI and MI met on a regular basis

events.description: MDI, Hazelton and CEI entered into the Contribution Agreement
events.quote: entered into a Contribution Agreement dated December 3, 2021

events.description: Meeting at MI's office: Mizrahi said the labourers were unionized and refused to provide T4 slips; CEI said it would approve no more labour expenses without support
events.quote: On March 9, 2023, Chris and I attended a meeting at MI

events.description: Hiscox asked David Ho to investigate the labour; Ho reported that MI used a third-party contractor with likely non-unionized labourers
events.quote: On March 10, 2023, I spoke with David Ho

events.description: Esteban sent the Breakdown Email with the hourly Labour Cost Breakdown
events.quote: On March 14, 2023, Esteban provided a breakdown by email

events.description: Hiscox forwarded the Breakdown Email to David Ho asking him to identify the third-party labour contractor
events.quote: forwarded the Breakdown Email to David to ask him to urgently determine the name of the third-party contractor

events.description: Second meeting at MI's office where Hiscox challenged the Breakdown Email; MI suggested CEI supply the labourers
events.quote: On March 16, 2023, I, along with Chris and David, again met with Mizrahi and Esteban

events.description: Lina White texted Hiscox that a worker said the labourers were not unionized, not MI employees, and were paid in cash
events.quote: Also on March 16, 2023, I was informed by my assistant, Lina White, through a series of text messages

events.description: Meeting with Mizrahi; Taline Melkonian gave Hiscox the CLM Invoice, which Hiscox photographed
events.quote: On March 22, 2023, Chris and I again attended on behalf of CEI at MI

events.description: Esteban replied that he had misunderstood and had given industry costs for organized labour
events.quote: Esteban responded to the Breakdown Email and stated that he misunderstood

events.description: MI sent Hazelton a notice terminating the CMA
events.quote: On May 10, 2024, MI sent a notice to Hazelton terminating the CMA
referenced_not_attached: Termination notice (Appendix N to the Fifth Report)

events.description: Mizrahi resigned as director and officer of Hazelton
Receivership Order appointed KSV Restructuring Inc. as receiver and manager
Receiver's counsel sent the Information Request Letter to CEI's counsel
CEI's counsel responded to the Information Request Letter (the CEI Letter)
referenced_not_attached: CEI Letter (Appendix L to the Fifth Report)
